name: @online-chess/desktop
description: Native Electron desktop application for Online Chess Platform
author: Online Chess Contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run prepare:renderer
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,ELECTRON -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:main && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB,ELECTRON -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:main && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
